In the corporate business, security related to next-generation SOC using AI grew significantly, supported by the security platform “Trend Vision One,” and network-related security also grew. In the consumer business, sales through mobile phone shops grew, while PC-related sales were sluggish. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥87,840 million.
entries.0d11d1432bcd00b8: This region covers the United States, Brazil and others. In the corporate business, new security investment was suppressed by uncertainty over the outlook for U.S. trade policy and others, and the consumer business was also affected by changes to sales channels. The U.S. subsidiary serves as a base for research and development and sales, and its revenue exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥55,187 million.
entries.15ee7cc05118d51f: This region covers Taiwan, Australia, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates and others. Backed by Vision One, next-generation SOC-related security using AI made a significant contribution, and email-related security also grew, with the Middle East, Taiwan and Singapore driving sales. The Taiwan subsidiary serves as a base for research and development and sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥71,516 million.
